```{r}
# Get chromosome lengths for standard chromosomes only
seqinfo_hg38 <- seqlengths(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
std_chroms <- grepl("^chr([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-2]|X|Y|M)$", names(seqinfo_hg38))
seqinfo_hg38 <- seqinfo_hg38[std_chroms]

# Tile into 500 bp non-overlapping windows
tiles_500bp <- GenomicRanges::tileGenome(seqinfo_hg38, tilewidth = 500, cut.last.tile.in.chrom = TRUE)

# Add a tile number column
tiles_500bp <- tiles_500bp %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  mutate(tile_num = 1:n()) %>%
  as_granges()

# cpgs
seqs <- c(seqnames(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38::BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)[1:22], "chrX", "chrY")

cg_sites <- lapply(seqs, function(x) {
  cbind(data.frame(Biostrings::matchPattern("CG", BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38::BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38[[x]])),
        seqnames = x
  )}) %>% bind_rows()

tiles_500bp_cg <- find_overlaps(tiles_500bp, as_granges(cg_sites)) %>% data.frame() %>%
  group_by(tile_num) %>% mutate(n_cg = n())
tiles_500bp_cg <- tiles_500bp_cg %>% ungroup() %>% distinct()

tiles_500bp_cg$tile_id <- paste0(tiles_500bp_cg$seqnames, ":", tiles_500bp_cg$start, "-", tiles_500bp_cg$end)

tiles_500bp_cg
```

```{r}
reads_chr <- function(read_data_path_a, tiles,
                       jit_amount = 0.1) {
  set.seed(42)

  # ── 1. Read only the matching rows — never loads unmatched data into RAM ───
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
  on.exit(dbDisconnect(con))
  
  tiles_df <- as.data.frame(tiles)[, c("seqnames", "start", "end", "tile_id")]
  tiles_df$seqnames <- as.character(tiles_df$seqnames)
  duckdb_register(con, "tiles", tiles_df)
  
  overlap_query <- function(path) {
    dbGetQuery(con, glue::glue("
      SELECT DISTINCT r.*, t.tile_id
      FROM read_parquet('{path}') r
      JOIN tiles t
        ON r.seqnames = t.seqnames
       AND r.start >= t.start
       AND r.end   <= t.end
    "))
  }
  
  
  read_data <- overlap_query(read_data_path_a)

  
  read_data$type <- "healthy"

  read_data <- read_data %>% mutate(alpha_group = case_when(alpha < 0.2 ~ "a < 0.2",
                                 alpha > 0.8 ~ "a > 0.8",
                                 alpha >= 0.2 & alpha <= 0.4 ~ "0.2 <= a <= 0.4",
                                 alpha > 0.4 & alpha < 0.6 ~ "0.4 < a < 0.6",
                                 TRUE ~ "0.6 <= a <= 0.8"))
  read_data <- read_data %>% mutate(alpha_group = factor(alpha_group, levels = c("a < 0.2", "0.2 <= a <= 0.4", "0.4 < a < 0.6", "0.6 <= a <= 0.8", "a > 0.8")))
#  read_data <- read_data %>% count(type, region_id, alpha_group, name = "tile_band_count") %>% group_by(region_id, type) %>% mutate(percent = tile_band_count/sum(tile_band_count)) %>% ungroup()
  sample_names <- unique(read_data$sample)
  read_data <- read_data %>% filter(total >= 3) %>% 
    mutate(transcript = paste0(region_id, "_", alpha_group)) %>%
  group_by(sample, transcript) %>%
  summarise(transcript_count = n()) %>% ungroup() %>% data.frame()
  
  read_data <- read_data %>% pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = transcript_count)
  read_data[is.na(read_data)] <- 0
  read_data$gene_id <- sub("_.*", "", read_data$transcript)
  
  c(read_data, sample_names)
}
```

```{r}
process_wgbs_short <- function(bismark, bed = NULL, s = seqs) {
  read <- bismark
  names(read) <- c("read_id", "strand", "seqnames", "start", "meth_status")
  read <- read[seqnames %chin% s]
  read$end <- read$start

  read_overlap <- read
  read_overlap[, meth_status := ifelse(meth_status == "Z", "M", "U")]
  read_overlap[, meth_pattern := paste0(meth_status, collapse = ""), by = read_id]
  read_overlap[, num_meth := str_count(meth_pattern, pattern = "M")]
  read_overlap[, total := str_length(meth_pattern)]
  read_overlap[, alpha := num_meth/total]
  read_overlap[, genom_positions := paste0(start, collapse = ","), by = read_id]

  read_overlap <- read_overlap %>% .[order(.$read_id),]

  read_overlap[, read_start := min(start), by = read_id]
  read_overlap[, read_end := max(start), by = read_id]

  read_overlap
}
```

```{r}
  mutate(alpha_group = case_when(alpha < 0.2 ~ "a < 0.2",
                                 alpha > 0.8 ~ "a > 0.8",

  mutate(transcript = paste0(tile_id, "_", alpha_group)) %>%
  group_by(sample, transcript) %>%
  summarise(transcript_count = n()) %>% ungroup() %>% data.frame()

dtu_optile$gene_id <- sub("_.*", "", dtu_optile$transcript)
```
